name: mirage
text: Mostly no, and one real risk. The sessions already have what the APIs publish (their docs are saved in the repo and the engine measures each feed's speed and accuracy itself), and for the metered ones the engine reads usage directly. An MCP would only add live docs lookup, which adds little. The risk: a connected MCP would hand a session your account/key access, and the repo rule is that sessions never open the one-connection sockets (Pinnodds, BoltOdds, Kalshi) or hold keys. Where it WOULD help: a read-only MCP/docs for an API we know least about (SGO, OddsPapi v5, Unabated: their real answers were never checked against live keys). A cheaper way to get the same: run each API's Test key button and send me the file.
